sid.description: The SID of the Transcription resource.

account_sid.description: The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that created this Transcription resource.

call_sid.description: The SID of the [Call](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/call-resource) the Transcription resource is associated with.

name.description: The user-specified name of this Transcription, if one was given when the Transcription was created. This may be used to stop the Transcription.

date_updated.description: The date and time in GMT that this resource was last updated, specified in [RFC 2822](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2822.txt) format.
